text:
Maya L: Kicking off the MeridianBridge POC — customer wants to drop CompetitorQ and asks for a compatibility validation. Key asks: prompt/response shape parity, per-call billing comparison, webhook signature mapping, and whether Hosted can meet their KMS/SAML needs. Can SE/security advise? cc @Omar R @Hannah S
Omar R: Quick Q: do they rely on streaming chunks for progressive render or only completions? Also need their top-100 request patterns.
Maya L: Mostly completions + a handful of streaming progress updates for long-running ops. We'll request logs.
Hannah S: On pricing, procurement asked for a trial flat fee to avoid token surprises. We can provide a capped two-week estimate; production will be per-token. QuoteBot: Note: flat-fee POCs must be approved by RevOps.
SecOps: Security checklist: EU data residency, SAML SSO for admin, weekly audit export, webhook HMAC mapping, and customer-managed KMS. Hosted supports signature verification and IP allowlist; Dedicated required for customer-managed KMS and mTLS callbacks.
Omar R: Proposed tech plan: 1) Handshake (creds, cURL examples, signature headers) day 0-1; 2) Parity smoke (500 prompts) day 2-4; 3) Billing replay to estimate token delta day 5; 4) Scale ramp to p95 day 6-7.
Omar R: Example cURL to share with their engineers:
```
# get token
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/auth -d '{"client_id":"MB-POC","client_secret":"..."}'
# call completion
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rw-medium-1","input":"Show my last 5 transactions"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
# webhook header
X-RW-Signature: sha256=... (HMAC-SHA256)
```
Hannah S: Acceptance criteria suggestion: 1) semantic parity >= 90% on spot-checks, 2) token cost delta <= 15% for the POC workload, 3) p95 latency < 300ms for single-shot gen, 4) webhook delivery >=99% with retries.
SecOps: MeridianBridge asked for mTLS on callbacks. Recommend Dedicated if they insist. I'll prepare a short threat model and signature mapping doc.
Maya L: I'll ask the customer for anonymized request samples, their webhook spec, and security questionnaire link. Target kickoff Monday (4/19). Owners: Omar (technical), Hannah (commercial), SecOps (security). Anything else?
Omar R: One more: CompetitorQ uses header X-CQ-Sig; include a mapping table so their engineers can swap header names during the POC.
Hannah S: I'll draft the capped POC quote and include optional add-on for Dedicated if KMS/mTLS required.
Maya L: Great — I'll assemble kickoff invite and SFTP details for secure upload. :ship:
